title: Dan Quinn on Jayden Daniels: Even through tough weeks, he is really resilient

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Quinn on Jayden Daniels: Even through tough weeks, he is really resilient
sources.description: The Commanders spent a lot of time talking about the blunders that cost them a chance to beat the Giants in overtime in Week 6, but the time has now come for them to turn the page to Monday night's game against the 49ers.
